name: Flash
description: Teleport a short distance forward or toward the aimed direction.

name: Ghost
description: Gain a burst of movement speed that settles into a longer movement-speed bonus; takedowns extend it.
use: Long chases, kiting, and extended fights.

name: Heal
description: Restore Health to you and the most wounded nearby ally, then grant both movement speed briefly.
use: Duo-lane survival and saving a nearby teammate.

name: Barrier
description: Gain a short-duration shield that absorbs incoming damage.
use: Surviving burst when you need a self-only defensive spell.

name: Ignite
description: Deal true damage over time and apply Grievous Wounds to reduce healing and regeneration.
use: Kill pressure and anti-heal against sustain-heavy targets.

name: Exhaust
description: Reduce an enemy champion's movement speed and damage dealt for a short time.
use: Peeling a diver or neutralizing a burst carry.

name: Smite
description: Deal true damage to monsters or minions and heal from monsters; upgrades to Chilling Smite.
use: Required for junglers to clear and secure objectives.

name: Chilling Smite
description: Secure large monsters with increased true damage, or damage a champion and steal movement speed.
use: The upgraded jungle spell for objective control and sticking to targets.

name: Cleanse
description: Remove disables and briefly gain immunity to further disables.
use: A specialized answer to dangerous crowd-control chains.

name: Teleport
description: After channeling, teleport to an allied champion, structure, or ward, with early-game target restrictions.
use: Cross-map pressure, returning to lane, and joining distant fights.
